1. (Currently Amended) A method comprising:
receiving requests and data records from a plurality of creditors to file bankruptcy documents with a plurality of different bankruptcy organizations;
automatically generating the bankruptcy documents with the received data records, wherein the bankruptcy documents are suitable for filing with different bankruptcy organizations;
batch filing the bankruptcy documents with the different bankruptcy organizations; and
__wherein the bankruptcy documents are generated in a format specific to each bankruptcy organization's filing requirements and the batch filing includes transforming the data records into organization-specific document formats before filing__.

2. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the different bankruptcy organizations are different courts with different filing system configurations __and wherein the method further comprises mapping data fields from the received data records to organization-specific filing formats prior to batch filing__.

6. (Currently Amended) A method comprising:
receiving requests from a plurality of creditors to file proofs of claims for debts owed by debtors to the creditors with a plurality of different bankruptcy organizations, wherein each request includes a data record for generating a proof of claim;
automatically generating the proofs of claims with the received data records, wherein the proofs of claims are suitable for filing with different bankruptcy organizations; and
batch filing the proofs of claims with the different bankruptcy organizations;
__wherein the proofs of claims are generated in formats compliant with each bankruptcy organization's specific filing requirements and the batch filing includes converting the data records into organization-specific proof of claim formats__.

7. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 6 wherein the different bankruptcy organizations are different bankruptcy courts having different filing system configurations __and wherein the proofs of claims are formatted according to each court's unique filing system requirements__.

8. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 6 further comprising sending bankruptcy notification messages to the plurality of creditors, wherein the bankruptcy notification messages notify the creditors __of specific proofs of claims filed on their behalf and the status of such filings with particular bankruptcy organizations__.

9. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 6 wherein receiving requests from the plurality of creditors comprises receiving the requests using a secure file transfer protocol __and wherein the received data records are validated and transformed into organization-specific formats before batch filing__.

10. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 6 wherein receiving requests comprises receiving requests via a Web site __and wherein the Web site interface formats the received data according to each bankruptcy organization's filing requirements__.

11. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 6 where batch filing comprises aggregating the proofs of claims __in organization-specific batches and filing the proofs of claims in a batch mode at least once per day with each bankruptcy organization__.

12. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 6 further comprising:
generating a report; and
sending the report to a particular creditor;
__wherein the report includes the status of proofs of claims filed with specific bankruptcy organizations and the formats used for each filing__.

13. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 12 wherein generating the report comprises enabling a user to request the report using a Web site __that displays filing status and organization-specific filing formats applied__.

14. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 12 wherein generating the report comprises generating an aging report specifying a reason some proofs of claims have not been filed __including reasons related to organization-specific filing format requirements__.

15. (Original) The method of claim 12 further comprising receiving a filing receipt for a filed proof of claim.

16. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 6 wherein batch filing is performed by a server computer __that transforms data records into organization-specific formats and manages filing with multiple bankruptcy organizations__.

17. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 6 further comprising validating the data record __and verifying compliance with each bankruptcy organization's filing format requirements__.
